prs.title: test: improve mutation coverage for src/_internal
prs.body:
## Summary

This PR improves the automated test suite for `src/_internal.ts` by adding targeted mutation tests. This increases the confidence in the code's correctness by ensuring that more logical branches are covered by tests.

## Changes

- Added new mutation test cases in `test/_internal.mac-mut.test.ts`.
- Updated `.ijst-stryker.config.json` to ensure proper configuration for the new tests.
- Updated test reports.

## Metrics

| Metric | Before | After | Change |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Coverage | 100% | 100% | 0% |
| Mutation Score | 78.95% | 86.84% | +7.89% |
| MAC | 78.95 | 86.84 | +7.89 |

## Checklist

- [x] Tests added/updated
- [x] No breaking changes

constraints: don't use introspection; follow the existing test style
